text: よろこんでる　うちに　まけちまったい

structure.jp: よろこんでる　うちに

patterns.name: 〜うちに
patterns.span: よろこんでる　うちに
patterns.explanation: うちに means 'while that was still going on'. よろこんでる　うちに = 'while I was busy being happy'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちまう is a rough, boyish short form of てしまう, saying something happened to your regret. まけちまった = 'I went and lost'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: よろこんでる is the spoken short form of よろこんでいる, something going on at the time. よろこんでる = 'am being happy'.
